lineage: A2 MMWAVE_PHASE_EXTRACTION_PROFILE_001 native unwrap on reused A6 bin/channel

timing.update_advancement_rule: accept event i only if phase_update_estimate_ms[i] > last_accepted_update_estimate_ms + 8; last_accepted is updated only when the event is kept
timing.update_advancement_tolerance_meaning: timestamp-quantization/jitter guard against the last accepted update estimate, not against the previous telemetry row

derivative.timestamp_assigned_to_derivative: t_update[i] of the later accepted event
derivative.predecessor_scope: accepted events in [t_start - 0.250 s, t_start) are retained only as left-hand derivative context
derivative.predecessor_rule: the first in-window R2 sample uses the immediately preceding accepted event as (x[i-1], t[i-1]); this is not an extra tensor channel
derivative.predecessor_count_guarantee: NOT_A_FIXED_COUNT_OF_EXACTLY_ONE; lookback may contain 0 or more accepted events
derivative.predecessor_if_absent: if the window starts at a recording or segment start and no predecessor exists, the first event still produces no R2; grid[0] may be filled only by edge hold <= 0.250 s
derivative.after_gap_reset: first new event starts a new segment and does not produce a cross-gap derivative

gap.formula: reject window if any accepted interval in the completed candidate window exceeds max(0.40 s, 4 * median_update_dt)
gap.median_update_dt_scope: accepted update intervals whose later event lies inside the completed candidate 30 s window
gap.initialization: if fewer than 8 intervals, reject the window; do not use a recording-wide or future median
gap.reset: boot/session discontinuity or large gap starts a new empty interval history

order: calculate R2 at native accepted-event times
resample R2 to the canonical 8 Hz grid
apply current-window S1 MAD to the 240 resampled values
resampling.edge_hold_meaning: nearest valid derivative value may cover an uncovered window edge only when the uncovered duration is <= 0.250 s; otherwise reject
resampling.time_ordering: index 0 is t_start, strictly increasing by 0.125 s

scale.applied_to: the 240 resampled R2 values of the completed window

target.window_identity_source: A6 30 s non-overlapping windows; labels reused, historical BPF_ZSCORE values not reused

class_semantics.NORMAL: Movesense chest-ACC RR in [10, 25) bpm with zero non-breathing overlap; rest-condition proxy, not a clinical diagnosis
class_semantics.RAPID_OR_ABNORMAL: Movesense chest-ACC RR < 10 bpm or >= 25 bpm
class_semantics.APNEA: voluntary breath-hold overlap >= 6 s and event duration >= 8 s; SafeNest APNEA proxy, not clinical apnea

target.ambiguous_policy: excluded from supervised TRAIN/VAL/NEW_MODEL_HELDOUT_TEST metrics; retained in lineage/inventory

derived_payload_policy: local/gitignored tmp or datasets/processed; do not commit large npy tensors with this freeze
